NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Isin tanin araci salat wakti diggah cisaabsaanamkeh sinni arac taamitimta. Sinni arac sinni aalatal raaqta.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Isin tanin araci salat wakti diggah cisaabsaanamkeh, kee Masgidil an faka tekkek masgid culteenik Salat caala fakaanamkeh sinni arac taamitimta. Sinni arac sinni aalatal raaqta.
NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Magaala korisseenik salat wakti isih qusbisaanamkeh, kee Masgidil an faka tekkek masgid culteenik Salat caala fakaanamkeh sinni arac taamitimta. Sinni arac sinni aalatal raaqta.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Kiblat gita kaamerah ublal ubulsaanamkeh kee sinni TVl tan xagissa kood ikriyaanamkeh sinni kaamera taamitimta. Suura ma dacrisimtaah sinni aalatak ayyu wakti ma yawqa.
NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Salat wakti sinni kalendaril ossaanamkeh, kee fakteenik sinni kalendaril tan taama salat waktil geytimtam ublaanamkeh kalendar culo taamitimta. Sinni kalendarih maxco sinni aalatal raaqta.
NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Salat wakti sinni kalendaril ossaanamkeh, kee fakteenik sinni kalendaril tan taama salat waktil geytimtam ublaanamkeh kalendar culo taamitimta. Sinni kalendarih maxco sinni aalatal raaqta.
NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Sinni salat wakti kee calaamisseen salat TV fan rubaanamkeh, app ahal tan networkal TV luk xagta. Maxco qellisimtaah namma aalat fanat sa gexa.
NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: “Diggah le alarm” dooritteen kassisiyya gurra alarm innal hayisimta, toysa sinni telefoon xongolo mali caalal hinnay Focus faka tanuk kaadu yaabbimta.
